packages.name: The Full Band Experience (Duo + Backing Tracks)
packages.subtitle: Piano/Keys, Powerhouse Vocals & JamZone Custom Backing
packages.description: Full-band energy without the 5-piece price tag or stage footprint. Using custom multi-track accompaniment via JamZone, Kyle and Sammy-Jay deliver a huge, dance-floor-ready sound spanning 80s, 90s, 00s, and modern anthems.

packages.name: The Intimate Duet
packages.subtitle: Stripped-Back Piano & Soulful Vocals
packages.description: Raw, emotional, and captivating. Built on our roots in musical theatre and storytelling, we reimagine iconic songs in 'A Soft Focus Style'—shifting effortlessly from delicate, pin-drop ballads to soaring vocal moments. Available 100% off-grid on battery power for up to 2 hours.
